D: Four teenage turtle brothers want to be accepted in New York and try to stop a gang of mutants.
P: Serve the mains when the turtles head up to the rooftops with pizza.
S: the turtles' home in the sewers
Pizza dough rolled up with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, sliced into scrolls and baked golden.
Avocado mashed with lime, coriander and chilli, served in a halved round loaf like a shell, with tortilla chips.
the turtles roaming New York's streets at night

Pork and garlic chive dumplings pan-fried until crisp and golden underneath, then steamed tender, with soy and black vinegar for dipping. Mix 400g pork mince with a bunch of finely chopped garlic chives, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and white pepper. Put a heaped teaspoon on each of 30 round wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry in a lidded pan with 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 100ml water, cover and steam 5 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp soy with 2 tbsp black vinegar.
M: Pizza dough stretched thin, tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes, folded New York style. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake on a very hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes. Cut into big slices and fold each in half to eat.
Superfly and his gang of mutants

Thin crust loaded with everything: Italian sausage, mushroom, capsicum, olives, red onion and pineapple under bubbling mozzarella. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin. Spread each with 3 tbsp passata mixed with oregano. Squeeze 300g Italian sausages out of their skins and fry in small pieces until browned. Top the bases with 400g grated mozzarella, the sausage, 150g sliced mushrooms, 1 sliced green capsicum, half a sliced red onion, a handful of olives and 200g pineapple pieces. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 12 minutes.
W: the green ooze that made the turtles
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and topped with bright green buttercream left to drip down the sides like ooze.
K: Kiwi fruit, lime, apple juice and mint blended with ice into a bright green slushie that glows like the ooze, no colouring needed. Peel 6 ripe kiwi fruit and put in a blender with the juice of 3 limes, 500ml cold apple juice, a handful of mint leaves and 3 tbsp honey. Blend until smooth, then add 3 cups of ice and blend again until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a kiwi slice and a mint sprig. Serve with wide straws.

s.note: the turtles' home in the sewers
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into a rectangle, spread with 125ml pizza sauce and scatter with 150g mozzarella and 80g sliced pepperoni. Roll up from the long side, cut into 12 rolls, sit in a lined tin and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

Mash 3 avocados with lime juice, chopped coriander, a chopped green chilli and salt. Cut the top off a cob loaf and hollow it out, then spoon the guacamole in so it looks like a turtle shell. Serve with corn chips and the torn bread.

w.note: the green ooze that made the turtles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter, icing sugar and green colouring until soft and spoon on top so it drips down the sides like ooze.
